title: [PM seat] domain:engine — 🟢 os-project-manager
body:
⚠️ **This post is the RECORD of state, not the state.** Every fire re-reads the labels. ⛔ Never read a count here as current.

📌 Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/engine.md`. ⛔ Not hand-copied per term. Seat 2 is #20966. It has been vacant since its own close; its last term was `os-tesla`, `session_01TQLy3Yq6vF4SDpTXdr3Uwi`. While seat 2 is vacant, every lane card is this seat's to pick.

Refreshed 2026-10-19T14:01Z (term 5, round 12: twenty-eight cards landed end to end, #24497 the newest; #24472's PR #24526 PASS on its delta and waiting on CI; #10757's PR #24533 in a fix round; #24341 unblocked and resumed in build; three p1 cards from cloud#3053 queued; #24512, #24515 and #24519 filed; one question in the decision box). Term 4 (`sunhaolin`, `session_01GP3comALHRcRBixS2TEnLF`) wrote no closing brief. Its ledger is the revision before this term's first refresh (edited 2026-10-16T02:43Z). Earlier terms:
- Term 3: closing brief 6186297098.
- Term 2: closing brief 6162388895.
- Term 1: closing brief 6159097642.

## 1. Current PM: 🟢 `os-project-manager`

- **Session:** `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`, seated on the maintainer's invocation `/pm-dispatch engine seat 1`. The takeover audit and opening marker is the first comment after this term's first refresh.
- **Seating arbitration:** no brief existed, so the seat took the conservative check. Term 4's last own output was its own last body edit. No lane card carried a seat-1 claim newer than #23609's (term 4). `check-handover.mjs --session=session_01GP3comALHRcRBixS2TEnLF --account=sunhaolin` exited 0. Term 4's session and Routine answer `not found` to this account, which is not a death signal; the 24h-silence reading is.
- **Wake Routine:** `trig_012GoH7rFSCPozVy7BdYyMDm`, self-bound to this session, hourly at minute 58. Term 4's `trig_01UKp5uBLgmRMMz8ZZpcRU5K` belongs to another account and is not this seat's.
- **Orders in force:** the maintainer, to this session: 「只处理 p1 p2的任务」, restated as 「暂时只处理 p1 p2 任务」. Read as: for now, this seat claims only `priority:p1` and `priority:p2` lane cards. p3 and ungraded cards stay in the queue until a later order. A `priority:p0` card is not named by the order: one arriving is reported to the maintainer at once rather than claimed silently.
- **Concurrency order:** the maintainer, to this session at 2026-10-19T01:04Z: 「并发加到3」. Read as: up to three devs building at once. It supersedes this seat's own pacing call of two under the `allowed_warning` reading (below).
- **Usage-wall deviation, ended:** the three cloud devs stopped on the account's weekly limit at 2026-10-17T14:18Z. Concurrency was lowered to 2 after the reset and restored to `batch` 3 when #24097's report landed at 2026-10-17T16:08Z.
- **Lapsed orders:** term 4's two orders (heavy cards as their own cloud sessions; serial dispatch after its in-flight work merged) were not restated to this session, so they lapse. `batch` is the default 3.
- **PR subscriptions held:** PR #24526 (#24472) and PR #24533 (#10757).
- **Pacing:** three cards in flight at this refresh (#24472 awaiting CI after its delta PASS, #10757 in a fix round, #24341 resumed), by the concurrency order. The next freed slot takes #24536, then #24537 (both p1). #24523 (p1) follows #10757's landing, because PR #24533 moves the same `readDefaultOrganizationId` call site. #24318 (p2) waits on #24472's outcome before its claim. The cloud devs still read `seven_day` usage at `allowed_warning`; the seat reports it if the reading turns to a wall.

## 2. Ledger (⛔ re-read the labels before acting)

**Landed this term** (each with a landing comment on its card):
- #24087 (p2): PR #24202. `searchAll` titles a hit by `nameField` before the deprecated `titleFormat`.
- #24086 (p1, `target:v18`): PR #24203 (`f3174efc4`). `installPackage` refuses a manifest the install declaration refuses. Cloud pin constraint: a cloud pin at or past `f3174efc4` must carry objectstack-ai/cloud#2978's merge (pointer 6238806520 on #6026).
- #24097 (p1, `target:v18`): PR #24208 (`a06f0d414`). The by-name `/meta` read refuses a disabled package's object.
- #24126 (p2): PR #24209 (`a19b2a7a5`). System Overview's metric tiles are one row tall.
- #24016 (p2): PR #24216 (`b0a1df044`). `sys_organization` declares the record-header invite action; leave folds to the overflow.
- #24182 (p2): PR #24221 (`aa31569b2`). Withdrawing an extender restores the owner's bridged copy.
- #24210 (p1, `target:v18`), first half: PR #24223 (`2bcd406a2`, `Part of`). A disabled package's non-object item reads absent by name. The REST event and diff doors no longer pass the per-caller gate. The echo keeps its binding.
- #24210, second half: PR #24247 (`e74ec56ac`, `Part of`). `_drafts` omits a disabled package's drafts; non-object `/published` takes the missing name's exits on both transports; REST `/state` refuses `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`; the event and diff doors answer the plain read's absence body. It was dequeued once on a semantic conflict with #23050 slice 13b (a dropped import), fixed and re-reviewed on the new head (record 6245404399, ACCEPT 6245503059).
- #24210, last part: PR #24267 (`58a2faa63`, `Fixes`; landing 6247668999). Non-object `/layers` and `?layers=true` read a disabled package's item absent on both transports, scoped by `?package=`. The card is closed.
- #24253 (p2): PR #24269 (`1e001c7df`, `Fixes`; landing 6247502956). `publishPackageDrafts` takes an opt-in per-field backfill of a literal `defaultValue` and reports `backfillApplied`. Pointer 6247510007 to objectui#12894: the UI release needs a pin at or past `1e001c7df`.
- #24197 (p1, `target:v18`), code part: PR #24274 (`d537a318b`, `Part of`; landing 6248094478). A formula field reads one hop through a reference, page-batched, under the reader's own permissions; the lint admits one hop and refuses two; a title formula over lookups answers `400 INVALID_SORT` / `400 INVALID_FIELD` when sorted or searched.
- #22788 (p2, ADR-0139 coordination): closed `completed` by its owner (6248295826) once triage unlocked it (6248134608). E6 and E7 are ticked in the body; all eight execution merges are on `main`. Leftovers are routed in §4.

**Landed this round:**
- #24284 (p1): PR #24320 (`ec749fbb44`, `Fixes`; landing 6250348531). A non-blank `search` over an empty resolved search set answers `400 INVALID_FIELD`. The routes are in 6250386227: objectstack-ai/objectui#12966 (the console), and pointers 6250371902 (`domain:cli`, the export stream) and 6250376162 (`domain:devx`, one catalog sentence).
- #24197 (p1), part 3, the last: PR #24323 (`68a090fb97`, `Fixes`, Tier H; landing 6250721273). The ADR-0079 addendum. `os-zhuang` approved it after the delta record 6250527790 (PASS, superseding FAIL 6250184223 on a hook-versus-action heading). The card is closed.
- #24316 (p1, `security`, `target:v18`): PR #24344 (`69147abf25`, `Fixes`; landing 6251892684). The shared one-hop loader never reads a stored-metadata-body table, under either authority; the lint refuses the same hop at save. Reach was measured before the fix (administrators, and members granted read on the family table, were served). Record 6251578116 PASS, ACCEPT 6251597603. Triage's release lean (6249611671), that `next.4` waits for this refusal, is met. Its two escalations are filed as #24358.
- #24314 (p1, `target:v18`): PR #24363 (`2f569a9de7`, `Fixes`; landing 6252993908). An `objectExtensions` body adds no platform system columns to the object it extends (the inherit route): `registerObject` plans base layers only, and audit governance follows the base plan (#4447). Record 6252593439 PASS, ACCEPT 6252630293. Consumer pointer 6252987818 on #24145 for objectstack-ai/cloud#3014 (no cloud edit required). The flipped dogfood pin runs only on the push to `main`: green there on `6868514b1c`, the first push carrying it that ran to completion (run 39150223027; the run on `2f569a9de7` was cancelled by the next push).
- #24301 (p1, `target:v18`, leg B of #24282): PR #24372 (`41c7405364`, `Fixes`; landing 6253182183). An organization-scoped seed load refuses a natural key only a NULL-organization row holds, as a named per-row error, and never adopts the row. Record 6252805355 PASS, ACCEPT 6252822792. With leg A (PR #24325) both legs are on `main`; pointer 6253188290 on #24282 for objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2146.
- #24358 (p1, `security`, `target:v18`): PR #24382 (`cf16a0d18a`, `Fixes`; landing 6254375548). The engine's `expand` and the master-detail `parent` root (all three binders) never hydrate a stored-metadata-body table. Reach was measured first: the reader classes #24316 named were served on both exits before the fix, and both exits are in published releases (the detail went to the maintainer in-session). Record 6254034266 PASS, ACCEPT 6254045803.
- #24371 (p1, `area:api`): PR #24391 (`182757145e`, `Fixes`; landing 6255089140). One `GET /api/v1/data` read makes one `sys_metadata` read of its object, not five: measured at 50 ms RTT, a median of 551 ms → 340 ms, with identical bodies. An object with a stored row makes 2 (the version head), disclosed. Review of record 6254708368 PASS (`TIER_DEFAULT`), ACCEPT 6254722707.
- #24299 (p1 since re-grade 6255097198, `target:v18`, `area:access`): PR #24397 (`62e2b6d01e`, `Fixes`; landing 6255645797). A rejecting `sys_api_key` read answers the store outage (`503`) on every door that admits keys, so a key sent beside another user's session cookie is no longer served as the cookie's user. A never-provisioned table still answers "no key". Record 6255307197 PASS, ACCEPT 6255313090.
- #24384 (p2, `area:identity`): PR #24399 (`f573976865`, `Fixes`; landing 6256241882). `MEMBERSHIP_REACH` gains `update_organization` (owner and admin) and `delete_organization` (owner), read off better-auth's statements. `sys_organization`'s edit, rename and delete actions follow them, so a plain member is offered only create, set active and leave. Record 6255881407 PASS (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, published-schema face), ACCEPT 6255899032.
- #24360 (p2, `area:i18n`): PR #24401 (`cf540a7713`, `Fixes`; landing 6256318357). Seven engine strings say "authored in this system" (objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A); copy only. Review of record 6256001058 PASS (`TIER_DEFAULT`), ACCEPT 6256010730.
- #24273 (p2, `area:identity`): PR #24412 (`8baeda5209`, `Fixes`; landing 6257791482). `sys_member.transfer_ownership` says what better-auth does: "Make Owner"; the selected member becomes an owner, the caller keeps their role, and stepping down is the caller's own Change Role (measured). Review of record 6257422660 PASS (`TIER_DEFAULT`), ACCEPT 6257445170. Cloud pointer 6257439197 on #24145.
- #24405 (p2, `area:i18n`): PR #24432 (`4d12b23f04`, `Fixes`; landing 6259089695). The SSO provider, OAuth-application and Connect-an-Agent copy say "this system" (the subtitle in one commit with its locale hashes); the uninstall refusal keeps ADR-0131 D6's "environment-wide". Review of record 6258708367 PASS (`TIER_DEFAULT`), ACCEPT 6258735715.
- #24335 (p2, `area:files`): PR #24434 (`9112bcd887`, `Fixes`; landing 6259133048). File-field hydration asks `canReadObject('sys_file')` before it reads, so a member's record read logs no denial and the body is byte-identical; the direct `sys_file` read still answers `403`. Review of record 6258712209 PASS (`TIER_DEFAULT`), ACCEPT 6258740216.
- #24395 (p1, `area:studio`, `target:v18`): PR #24418 (`2ec6827962`, `Fixes`; landing 6261884869). The draft save records `draftChanges`, the surface, actor and instant of each key path. It is stored on a nullable `sys_metadata.draft_changes` column and served on the strict draft read only. Both HTTP doors take `?surface=studio|api`, and `copilot` is in-process only. Record 6259630019 PASS (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`), carried to `49a8e27c6a` by delta 6260922663 after the `18.0.0-next.4` cut; ACCEPT 6259637042. Pointers: cloud 6261860060 on #24145, objectstack-ai/objectui#12725 (6261868024).

- #24411 (p1, `target:v18`, `bug`): PR #24479 (`33a45ccadd`, `Fixes`; landing 6262207896). The object save's destructive gate reports `field_removed` and `field_type_change` only for a stored previous field, judged by the spec's `isVirtualSearchField`. A formula removal saves `200` without `force`; stored removals keep their `409`. Record 6261617754 PASS (`TIER_DEFAULT`), ACCEPT 6261643995. Cloud pointer 6262196232 on #24145 for cloud#2925.

- #24410 (p1, `target:v18`, `bug`): PR #24466 (`45bec43cd9`, `Fixes`; landing 6262682891). The save door refuses a formula reading a field its lookup's target does not declare, under `expression-invalid`. One failed hop no longer nulls its sibling formulas. Record 6260609012 FAIL (the core census row), then delta 6262025060 PASS; ACCEPT 6262132765. Cloud pointer 6262663077.

- #24414 (p1, `target:v18`, `area:access`): PR #24478 (`ca426cb65d`, `Fixes`; landing 6263953321). `current_user.hasCapability(name)` sits beside `can()` in the formula standard library, answered from `EvalContext.systemPermissions`, the list the action gate reads; with no list it throws, as `can()` does. The page component's `visibleWhen` describe names it. Record 6261910322 PASS (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`), carried to `1a3f686027` by delta 6262850662 after the #24460 conflict round; ACCEPT 6263345735. Pointers: cloud 6263933798 on #24145 for cloud#3036, objectstack-ai/objectui#13006 (6263944850).

- #24459 (p2, `bug`, `area:records`): PR #24502 (`3ae0b777d4`, `Fixes`; landing 6264432816). Every seed-loader site that judges "has a reference value" asks the engine's `isMissing`: a blank optional lookup loads with `success: true` and replays clean, a required one stays the engine's required check, and a blank multi-value element is dropped. Record 6263609121 PASS (`TIER_DEFAULT`), ACCEPT 6263880661. Cloud pointer 6264419516 on #24145 for cloud#3062.

- #24468 (p1, `target:v18`, `bug`): PR #24508 (`913fd6df8a`, `Fixes`; landing 6264833124). The save door refuses a validation rule condition reading, one hop through a lookup, a column the target does not declare (`expression-invalid`), and one misspelt rule no longer leaves its siblings without a verdict. Record 6264118179 PASS (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, narrowing face), ACCEPT 6264204668. Cloud pointer 6264817882 for cloud#2925; its ③.10 finding is #24512.

- #24497 (p1, `target:v18`, `area:access`): PR #24518 (`04669a467e`, `Fixes`; landing 6267886111). A `runAs: 'user'` hook fired from a hand-built system context gets `org_user_ids` (and, when it carries none, the user's own grants) where its `runAs` is resolved, through `resolveUserAuthzGrants`, by PR #24495's rule. The seed is keyed on an unexported symbol, so no public surface moves. Record 6265937412 FAIL on ② (a public method on the exported `ScopedContext`), then delta 6267161870 PASS after route A; ACCEPT 6267178743. `plugin-approvals`' producer gaps are #24519.

**In flight:**
- #24472 (p2, `bug`): PR #24526 (`bb02d9415`, report 6267065299). A same-name foreign bound action is reported at `kernel:ready`, naming both packages, and `registerAction`'s cross-owner replacement is warned; report only, by 6262054499. Record 6267837597 FAIL on ② alone (a public method on the exported `SchemaRegistry`). Fix round 1 (route A, an unexported symbol) is at `bb02d9415` (report 6268501383). Delta 6268615812 **PASS** (`TIER_DEFAULT`); the PR body was patched to this head. The ACCEPT waits on CI.
- #10757 (p2): PR #24533 (`4746b38c1`, report 6267599450; body patched to `Fixes`, since leg A was ruled out at 6265874149). Legs 4, 5 and 6 landed and the cold leg ruled out; re-reading with the opt-ins on 3 / 3, stock 11 / 6 admin and 10 / 6 member. Record 6268067889 PASS (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`). CI red on `Test Core (5/6)`: an objectql test writes `sys_metadata` straight into the driver after a cached read (note 6268090803); fix round 1 is with the dev. Cross-lane: `domain:devx` (6267689991, 6267701042) and `domain:spec` (6267709075, 6267716787). The `epic:#15194` declaration 6264887348 has had no answer and no objection.
- #24341 (p1, `target:v18`, `area:access`): unblocked 6267968489 (both producers landed); resume claim 6267997774, dispatch 6268030239, dev `session_01FatVyDAFEST48jZDQcbheU`, from `1bf6312ed9` with `main` merged. Owes the merged `||` pin, #24340's ③.11 baseline pin and a narrowing-face review. #24484 waits on it.

**Decision box:** one question open, with the maintainer in-session.
- 2026-10-18T19:06Z: #24358's open question (a), whether to add an author-time refusal of a `lookup` or `master_detail` into a family table (a `packages/lint` rule, declared to `domain:spec`), beside the engine guards that have landed. The seat leans B, as its own follow-up card.

**Answered:** #24449, ruled A′ at 6261536443 (batch #370 item 1, the maintainer's 「24449 24289 同意」); the card is closed. The 17.x question. The maintainer, in-session at 2026-10-19T01:40Z: 「17.x 不处理」. Read as: no backport of #24358's guards to the 17.x line and no 17.x patch cut; the fix ships on the 18 line only. Earlier: #24020 was ruled D (6245529829, the maintainer's 「24020 D」) and closed `not_planned` (6245889328).

**Lane queue** (`domain:engine` + `pm:queue`, unclaimed, p1/p2), held by the concurrency order; a freed slot takes a p1 first:
- #24536 (p1, `bug`, `area:records`): filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat from cloud#3053. The formula CEL environment (`buildEnv` → `registerStdLib`) is built on every compile and evaluate, about 7% of a read's CPU. Next in line.
- #24537 (p1, `bug`, `area:access`): from cloud#3053. Permission-set resolution probes the filesystem on every request (`findFile`'s `fs.access` per extension in `packages/metadata`'s filesystem loader), about 5% of a read's CPU. If the fix touches `plugin-security`, it is declared to `domain:services`.
- #24523 (p1, `bug`, `area:access`): from cloud#3053. Every authenticated request re-reads the Default Organization (`readDefaultOrganizationId`, two sequential `sys_organization` reads) once the admin grant is organization-owned. Waits for #10757's landing (the same call site in `resolve-authz-context.ts`); its claim also declares to the `epic:#15194` lane, which holds the C8 organization-less anchor.
- #24318 (p2, `area:identity`): back in the queue 2026-10-19T08:01Z (note 6262556066), since #24400 closed through PR #24458 (`fb0d85b7fb`). Shape B (release 6255698861): cloud's composition declares `change_slug` through the new route, and the platform object stops declaring it. Its claim reads #24472's outcome first (in build).

- #24512 (p2, `bug`, `area:records`): triage 6265543836 routes it to hydrating a `conditional`'s `when` through a lookup (`collectPredicateRelationships` and `checkConditional`), with the lint opting `when` into the hop checks.

#24336 is p3 and is not admitted by the orders. #24561 and #24562 (filed 2026-10-19T13:44Z) carry no `priority:*` yet: they wait for triage.

**Not dispatchable:** `pm:blocked` #15212 and #14570. `pm:on-hold` #24027, #21821, #8740, #7877 and #5930.

## 3. Hot-file serial queue (regions, ⛔ not files)

`core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`'s two sequenced reads and its localization cache entry, and `metadata-protocol`'s overlay cache and `getMetaItem`'s served read: #10757 (PR #24533), in a fix round (declared to the `epic:#15194` lane, 6264887348). The identity objects' `defaultRowScope` declarations and `objectql/src/registry.ts`'s `extend` refusal: #24341, resumed. `objectql/src/registry.ts`'s bound-action attach and audit (`attachBoundActions`, `boundCodeActions`, `findUnboundActionTargets`), `plugin.ts`'s `kernel:ready` report and `engine.ts`'s `registerAction`: #24472, delta PASS, awaiting CI. The `epic:#15194` lane (#15194's body) holds `engine.ts`'s tenant derivation, `buildDriverOptions` and the insert and upsert tenant path; this seat's regions do not meet it. #23561 (`domain:spec`) holds `protocol.ts`'s `duplicatePackage` region.

The regions PR #24518 (`ScopedContext`'s hook seed, `installRunAsApi`), PR #24508 (the predicate seam and the lint's rule-condition hop judgment), PR #24502 (the seed loader's reference skips), PR #24478 (the formula standard library's permission predicates, `EvalContext`, the page `visibleWhen` describe), PR #24466 (the formula one-hop read and `judgeFieldFormula`), PR #24479 (the object-save destructive gate), PR #24418 (the draft save, the strict draft read and the two HTTP save doors), PR #24267, PR #24269, PR #24274, PR #24307, PR #24320, PR #24344, PR #24363, PR #24372, PR #24382, PR #24391, PR #24397, PR #24399, PR #24401, PR #24412, PR #24432 and PR #24434 held (the layered chain, `publishPackageDrafts`, the formula read path, `serveFormulaField` and `buildTitleSurface`, the search expansion, the one-hop loader's family guard, the `objectExtensions` registration path, the seed loader's scoped pre-load, the `expand` and `parent` hydrations, the data door's overlay reads, `resolveApiKeyAdmission`, `sys_organization`'s admin actions and the two reach rows, the seven "this system" strings, `transfer_ownership`'s copy, the SSO/OAuth/MCP-connect copy, `resolveFileReferences`) have no holder since their merges.

**Seat 2's regions** are listed in #20966 §3.

## 4. Notes

- **Publication register:** merges publish through the changesets release PR. No verification layer is registered, so it reads as unverified.
- **Below-gate pointer** 6234291666 (`domain:cli` seat 1): `applyArtifactForwardConversions` (`packages/metadata-core`) throws on a non-string nested `manifest.engines.protocol`, though documented "never throws". It is not a card; no public door has been measured giving a wrong result.
- **Filed this round, from PR #24508's record ③.10:** #24512, a `finding` (gate ①, a metadata-authoring trap): a `conditional` rule's `when` read through a lookup saves at every door but is evaluated unhydrated, so every write it guards is refused. For triage.
- **Cut this round, by retriage 6256237052:** #24515 (p2, `domain:services`), #10757's leg A: `plugin-auth` leaves better-auth's `advanced.database.joins` unset, so `sys_user` is read in a second round after `sys_session`.
- **Filed this round, from PR #24466's record:** #24468, a `finding` (gate ①, class a, `reach:` the named producer `resolvePredicateRelated` → `resolveOneHopRelated` under `authority: 'predicate'`), graded p1 `target:v18` by triage 6260730682 (§2).
- **Filed earlier this round, from #24341's stop:** #24449, the decision card (§2), and #24448, a `finding` (gate ①, class a, `reach:` the named producer `resolveRunDataContext`): a `runAs:'user'` flow's data context carries no `org_user_ids`, so the shipped `sys_user_org_members` policy denies and the run sees only the user's own row, today. Triage graded it p1 `target:v18` in `domain:services` (6259397801), with the hook path as a `domain:engine` rider.
- **Filed earlier this round:** #24400, a `finding` (gate ①, class b) from PR #24399's dev report (6255528203, out-of-scope finding 1). `ObjectExtensionSchema`'s guidance tells an author to declare a top-level action with `objectName` and says `defineStack()` attaches it; for an object another package owns it is never attached, measured on a booted showcase. It is #24318's prerequisite. Triage graded it p1 `target:v18` in `domain:spec` (6256196520).
- **Filed earlier:** #24284, graded p1 by triage and landed (§2).
- **Filed in round 7:** #24358, a `[security]` card in the same family, escalated by PR #24344's record (6251578116, ③): the engine's `expand` relationship hydration and the master-detail `parent` root are two exits outside the one-hop loader. Category and position only. Triage graded it p1 `security` `target:v18` (6251978797); this seat dispatched it, measurement first (§2). The detail went to the maintainer in-session.
- **Filed earlier this round:** #24316, a `[security]` card in the stored-metadata-body family: a formula's one-hop read through a reference is an exit the family's projection does not reach. It was read in code only, by PR #24307's record (③.6), and is filed under the filing gate's possible-data-leak exception, with "measure reach first" as its first point. It names the category and the position only (#21207's convention); the detail went to the maintainer in-session. It is ungraded; this seat dispatches it, measurement first, once triage grades it.
- **Below-gate pointers:**
  - PR #24466 record 6260609012 ①.8: the `[#22661]` census's `engine.ts` row names `referenceExists` and `resolvePredicateRelated` as reads that serve no value. Since #24197 the formula one-hop read serves a related value under the reader's own permissions, and it asks no exposure decision of the target. The formula is author-declared, not client-chosen like `$expand`, so this reads as a design question in #22661's class and not a measured exposure. It was put to the maintainer in-session; not filed.
  - PR #24399 record 6255881407 ③: `positions` come from the active organisation (`resolve-authz-context.ts:1414`), while better-auth's organisation doors check the membership in the request's `organizationId`. A principal with different grades in two organisations can be offered a button on the other one's row that the door refuses, or not offered one it admits.
